design: Pasket basket with overlapping ivory cards, a central P aperture and two side apertures.

variants.name: Silver
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production macOS Dock app icon PNG for Pasket.
Input image: edit target, the approved basket design.
Recolor basket and thick rim to luminous SPACE SILVER: satin anodized aluminum, cool pale silver with medium-silver shadow faces and clearly dark graphite cutouts; rounded square tile is pearl silver with cool gray bevel; cards are off-white. Silver must be brighter than graphite, tactile and restrained, not mirror chrome. Keep the exact geometry and original composition.
Prepare this as an actual app icon asset: remove ONLY the outer flat presentation backdrop around the rounded-square tile and replace it with true transparent alpha. KEEP the rounded square colored tile itself OPAQUE with its existing smooth corners and subtle bevel. Keep basket, rolled rim, two overlapping ivory cards, central P aperture and side apertures exactly as reference. Preserve lighting. Keep the tile centered and occupying about 82 percent of the square canvas, with matching even transparent padding. Remove any rectangular background, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground plane. Only a restrained soft contact shadow around the tile if needed, no wide background haze. Single icon, square image, no text, labels or watermark. No redesign.
